allowed: Non-destructive network/service enumeration of in-scope IPs (port discovery + version/vuln detection on open ports)
Web application testing (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, auth bypass, path traversal, LFI/RFI, command injection, ReDoS) against in-scope endpoints
Read-only API interaction (GET/POST/OPTIONS/HEAD) and safe parameter fuzzing
Limited, non-destructive validation of discovered vulnerabilities (minimum proof only)
prohibited: Credential stuffing, password spraying, brute force, MFA bypass
